visual_identity.core_identity: A small swarm of ugly flying blood-feeders combining batlike wings with long needle proboscises and grasping feet.
visual_identity.silhouette: Several small airborne bodies with outspread membrane wings and long straight proboscises projecting from their faces.
visual_identity.head_features: Small animal-like head dominated by a long needle feeding tube, simple eyes, no humanoid expression.
visual_identity.body_shape: Compact flying body with membranous wings, small legs or grasping feet, and narrow abdomen.
visual_identity.surface: Smooth membrane wings and sparse body texture; avoid dense insect detail.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw several tiny compact flying pests, each built around one small animal-like body, one long straight needle proboscis projecting from the face, and one pair of membrane wings. Keep every individual tiny and non-humanoid; no giant leader, humanoid torso, dragon head, horns, or reptilian tail.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Each stirge has one compact body, one long facial proboscis, one pair of membrane wings, and small grasping legs/feet; never add humanoid arms or a separate heroic torso.

accuracy_checks: feeding or attack posture does not obscure creature identity
creatures are not mistaken for bats
each stirge is a tiny compact flying animal, never humanoid
no single giant creature dominates the group
long straight proboscis is the defining face feature

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

description: A small swarm of ugly flying blood-feeders combining batlike wings with long needle proboscises and grasping feet. Compact flying body with membranous wings, small legs or grasping feet, and narrow abdomen. Smooth membrane wings and sparse body texture; avoid dense insect detail. Several small airborne bodies with outspread membrane wings and long straight proboscises projecting from their faces.

scene_identity.size_impression: Tiny flying feeders that remain individually small and comparable in scale; the group never contains a human-sized focal creature.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Small bodies fly, cling, or feed with membrane wings and grasping feet while long straight proboscises orient toward targets.

known_failure_modes.symptom: one or more stirges become winged humanoid/dragon/demon figures
known_failure_modes.correction: restore tiny compact non-humanoid bodies with one membrane wing pair, small grasping legs, and long facial proboscis

known_failure_modes.symptom: one oversized stirge dominates the group
known_failure_modes.correction: keep individuals similarly tiny with no giant focal leader
